name: Minimal
description: One paragraph, one attribution line, hashtags. Nothing else. For channels where the description is a formality and the video does the work, and for anyone who wants the shortest thing that still satisfies the platform.
architecture: One paragraph, one attribution line, hashtags — no headers at all.

sections.instruction: One paragraph saying what this episode is. Plain and complete, with no opening flourish and no closing invitation.
One line naming who made or narrated it, if the story context says. If it does not, write nothing at all for this section.
Emit only hashtags, on a single line, separated by spaces. No sentence, no heading, no commentary. At most five.

title_plan.guidance: The plainest accurate name for the episode. No subtitle, no colon, no framing device.

tag_plan.guidance: for this episode, choosing only tags that are unambiguously about its subject

constraints: No greeting, no sign-off, no call to action anywhere.
Nothing rhetorical: no questions, no suspense, no promises.
